From: Ella Ramirez <ella@starnet.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@starnet.io
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payment authorization & PO routing for upcoming term

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Starnet is ready to move forward with the 2x capacity increase (Dedicated pool + hosted bursts) as discussed. Procurement just asked for two quick items so we can complete the purchase order:

- Please confirm whether Redwood can accept Net60 on the renewal amendment instead of your standard Net30.
- We need a billing contact and email to put on the PO and remit invoices. Our AP team will route payment to the billed entity on the invoice.

Attached is our official PO (Starnet_PO_7843.pdf) and a copy of our W-9 (Starnet_W9.pdf). PO number: ST-7843.

If Net60 is acceptable we will sign the amendment this week and kick off the payment schedule. Please let me know if you need any tax or entity info beyond the W-9.

Thanks,
Ella Ramirez
Procurement Manager
Starnet Systems
ella@starnet.io
attachments: Starnet_PO_7843.pdf (application/pdf), Starnet_W9.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment authorization & PO routing for upcoming term

Hi Ella —

Appreciate the PO and W-9, and congrats on getting procurement across the line. Quick answers and next steps:

- Net60: We can accommodate Net60 for this renewal as an exception. I'll flag the contract amendment with Legal so the billing terms are explicit.
- Billing contact: please confirm the preferred email/address you want on the invoice. If you want invoices to go to a separate AP mailbox we can route them there.
- Invoice split: you mentioned dedicated vs hosted capacity — do you want one consolidated invoice or two separate invoices (one for Dedicated, one for Hosted usage)? Some customers prefer separate lines for cost-center mapping.

Action items on our side:
- I'll send the amendment to Priyom to add Net60 language and return a signed copy for your countersignature.
- Marissa (cc) will handle PO ingestion and map ST-7843 to the HubSpot deal so finance recognizes the commitment.
- Neha (cc) — can you confirm the correct billing entity name and remit instructions we should print on the invoice?

If you confirm billing email and whether you prefer split invoices, we'll take it from there.

Onward,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com

Jonas — thanks.

Billing contact for AP: accounts-payable@starnet.io (Accounts Payable Team)
Please address invoices to: Starnet Systems, Attn: Accounts Payable, 1200 Meridian Ave, Suite 400, San Mateo, CA 94401

We would prefer two invoices:
- One invoice for Dedicated capacity (cost center: CLOUD-DED)
- One invoice for Hosted usage / overage (cost center: CLOUD-HOST)

PO ST-7843 covers both lines; please include the PO number on each invoice. Net60 is confirmed from our side.

I also attached the signed PO to this reply for convenience. If you need an executed amendment we can sign via DocuSign — send it over.

Best,
Ella
